verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.adyen.com that covers point-of-sale, plus markdown versions of the in-person payments docs pages (e.g. point-of-sale.md) that an agent can ingest directly. Many POS doc pages are served at .md URLs, which corroborates broad agent-readable coverage. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explaining or promoting the llms.txt/markdown docs for agent use, and confirmation of how completely llms.txt indexes the POS section beyond the truncated probe.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
